observations.visible_description: A white industrial cart or workstation with mechanical components mounted on top; it has a flat base and supports various parts including what appears to be engine assemblies.
Another similar white industrial cart/workstation positioned adjacent to device 1, also carrying complex machinery or automotive subassemblies like engines or transmissions.
A large gray rectangular box-like structure (possibly a cabinet or storage unit) located behind and slightly above the right-side cart; it has no visible openings and appears solid from this angle.

observation: Devices 1 and 2 are separate carts placed side by side on the factory floor, each supporting its own set of mechanical components. Device 3 is a stationary gray box positioned behind cart 1 but does not physically support or contain any other device — nor is it contained within another. No two different numbered devices visibly support or contain one another; all are distinct units operating independently in the assembly environment.
